metadata.hypothesis: A fresh bounded RCSB source search may expose clean ePK kinase-substrate positive evidence with gamma-transfer or equivalent transition-state geometry and source-mapped phosphoacceptor residues.
metadata.primary_outcome_reason: Fresh bounded searches found clean review-only peptide-substrate evidence for CDK2/Cyclin A and PKA, plus two CDK2/Cyclin A ADP/MGF transition-state mimic structures with source-mapped substrate peptide Thr acceptors. No new folded-protein substrate positive was found beyond known 5HVK.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: "protein kinase" "substrate peptide" ATP magnesium
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: manual source review accepts 1QMZ, 3X2U, 3X2V, 3X2W, and 4IAC as peptide positive-like evidence; rejects 4HPU and proteasome ATPase substrate-translocation rows as counterexamples.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: "protein kinase" "protein substrate" ATP magnesium
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: no fresh folded-protein ePK positive; the only ePK-like geometry hits are the same PKA SP20 peptide structures.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: tyrosine kinase substrate peptide ATP analog magnesium
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: 1IR3 is a known positive repeat; 2PVF is a clean FGFR2 substrate-peptide source near-miss but the substrate Tyr OH is 6.956 Angstrom from ACP PG, outside the current 6 Angstrom geometry rule.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: Michaelis complex protein kinase substrate peptide ATP
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: exhausted exact Michaelis wording; it adds no fresh folded-protein positive beyond the PKA peptide structures.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: protein kinase transition state mimic substrate MGF
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: both structures are accepted as clean review-only peptide transition-state evidence for CDK2/Cyclin A with ADP/MG/MGF and source-mapped CDK2 substrate peptide Thr acceptor.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: protein kinase substrate peptide MGF
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: only 3QHR and 3QHW are ePK transition-state substrate-peptide evidence; the remaining eight rows are GTPase GDP/MgF3 contexts.
the only source-free heteromeric geometry hit is known positive repeat 5HVK; no new folded-protein positive was found.

search_surfaces.query_or_source: RCSB full_text: phosphoacceptor protein kinase substrate
search_surfaces.manual_adjudication: no heteromeric gamma geometry hits. The PAK4/Paktide rows are source-relevant peptide complexes, but the only ANP/MG row checked manually, 4JDI, lacks a modeled terminal PG atom and therefore is not gamma-transfer measurement-ready.
recovers known peptide positives 1O6K, 1O6L, and 4EKK, and known/repeated counterexamples 4HPU and 7ZE5. It adds no fresh folded-protein positive evidence.

evidence_against.structure_title: Crystal Structure of Tyrosine Phosphorylated Activated FGF Receptor 2 (FGFR2) Kinase Domain in Complex with ATP Analog and Substrate Peptide
evidence_against.reason_not_clean_positive: source context is clean but the measured ACP PG-to-acceptor distance is outside the current 6 Angstrom candidate geometry rule
RCSB text surface matches substrate plus ATP/Mg, but structures are proteasome ATPase substrate-processing complexes, not ePK phosphoryl-transfer substrate complexes.

the heteromeric scout hits kinase-chain Ser/Thr acceptors near ANP on the inhibitor/substrate-chain ligand context; this repeats a known source-mode counterexample rather than source-mapped substrate acceptor evidence.

evidence_against.structure_title: Occ(apo/return) conformation of CydDC mutant (E500Q.C) in ATP(CydC)/AMP-PNP(CydD) bound state (Dataset-23)
evidence_against.reason_not_clean_positive: the AMP-PNP/protein wording returns a CydDC transporter ATPase complex with local hydroxyl geometry, not an ePK kinase-substrate phosphotransfer complex.
PAK4/Paktide source context is relevant, but 4JDH, 4JDJ, and 4JDK have no gamma-capable ligand and 4JDI models ANP/MG without a terminal PG atom in atom-site coordinates.
MGF search matches transition-state analog language but these are GDP/MgF3 small-GTPase or GAP complexes, not protein kinase substrate complexes.

recommendation: Record this run as evidence_for clean review-only peptide and transition-state analog positive evidence, but do not activate production scoring. The next query should focus on non-peptide folded protein-substrate co-complexes with source-mapped acceptors because this run found zero fresh folded-protein positives beyond known 5HVK.
